data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 302.5m (2018: GBP 193.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 8.4m (2018: improvement of GBP 9.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health Energy and Marine classes with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 510.238m. On a gross basis the syndicate recorded adverse prior-year development predominantly on the 2017 underwriting year, with an aggregate gross strengthening of approximately GBP 22.18m (c.4.35% of opening reserves). The managing agent attributes the movements principally to unfavourable developments in Property, Third party liability (Casualty), Accident & Health, Energy and Marine lines, partly offset by favourable development across other classes. Note that a separate narrative refers to a net deterioration of GBP 8.4m included in net claims incurred (after reinsurance).
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of GBP 8.4m (2018: improvement of GBP 9.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health Energy and Marine classes with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Historic development includes a mix of prior year releases and deteriorations, and in 2019 gross and net deteriorations occurred.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities - Claims outstanding) prior-year column (2018). Prior-year development calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) using the 2017 underwriting year (current estimate 216,540 less prior diagonal 194,361 = +22,179 GBP 000 = GBP 22.179m). The report also states a deterioration of GBP 8.4m in claims reserves within net claims incurred - that GBP 8.4m figure is reported as net of reinsurance in the narrative; gross and net figures differ. RITC adjustments (notably a large RITC adjustment removing 2016 & prior balances) are present in the technical provisions reconciliation and could distort simple comparisons; the triangle and reconciliation have been used with caution. Figures in the accounts are presented in GBP '000; primary monetary fields above are converted to millions as required.
